taxonomy.name: Non-Inclusive Identity Options
taxonomy.description: Users express frustration over rigid binary gender choices, lack of non-binary or custom pronoun settings, and heteronormative or body-shaming assumptions in readings.

taxonomy.name: Deceptive Subscriptions and Billing
taxonomy.description: Users report being unexpectedly charged for recurring subscriptions, full annual fees, or hidden web charges immediately after signing up for trials or one-time reports.

taxonomy.name: Unhelpful Support and Refunds
taxonomy.description: Users complain that customer service is unreachable, relies on automated bots, refuses valid refund requests, and closes support tickets without resolving issues.

taxonomy.name: Excessive Paywalls and Feature-Locking
taxonomy.description: Users criticize the app for placing basic astrology data, birth charts, and previously free features behind expensive ongoing subscription fees.

taxonomy.name: Predatory Per-Minute Psychic Billing
taxonomy.description: Users report that live psychic and advisor chats are overpriced and feature slow-responding readers or timers that quickly drain purchased credits.

taxonomy.name: Intrusive In-App Advertisements
taxonomy.description: Users complain about constant pop-up ads and aggressive promotion of paid services that repeatedly interrupt basic app navigation and chart viewing.

taxonomy.name: Technical Glitches and Bugs
taxonomy.description: Users experience app-breaking bugs including login failures, frozen loading screens, broken widgets, audio glitches during calls, and age-selection errors.

taxonomy.name: Recycled and Low-Quality Content
taxonomy.description: Users highlight poorly written, generic, or outdated horoscopes that contain obvious typos, contradictory advice, or recycled text from previous months and years.

themes.description: Users report being unexpectedly charged for recurring subscriptions, full annual fees, or hidden web charges immediately after signing up for trials or one-time reports.
themes.recommendation: Clearly disclose recurring charges, billing intervals, and subscription conversion terms before users confirm trial or low-cost report purchases.

themes.description: Users criticize the app for placing basic astrology data, birth charts, and previously free features behind expensive ongoing subscription fees.
themes.recommendation: Provide free or standard subscribers access to essential astrological features like birth charts and daily insights without requiring added payments for every detail.

themes.description: Users complain that customer service is unreachable, relies on automated bots, refuses valid refund requests, and closes support tickets without resolving issues.
themes.recommendation: Establish a responsive support team that actively resolves cancellation issues and billing disputes rather than relying on auto-closing automated ticket systems.

themes.description: Users report that live psychic and advisor chats are overpriced and feature slow-responding readers or timers that quickly drain purchased credits.
themes.recommendation: Offer flat-rate session pricing or credit caps for psychic chats so users are not billed excessively during delayed response times and introductory greetings.

themes.description: Users experience app-breaking bugs including login failures, frozen loading screens, broken widgets, audio glitches during calls, and age-selection errors.
themes.recommendation: Resolve persistent app loading errors, fix broken home screen widgets, and correct accurate natal chart calculations to ensure core features function properly.

themes.description: Users highlight poorly written, generic, or outdated horoscopes that contain obvious typos, contradictory advice, or recycled text from previous months and years.
themes.recommendation: Audit and refresh horoscope content regularly to eliminate outdated dates, typos, and repeated daily readings.

themes.description: Users complain about constant pop-up ads and aggressive promotion of paid services that repeatedly interrupt basic app navigation and chart viewing.
themes.recommendation: Reduce the frequency of repetitive pop-up ads and allow users to customize push notifications to prevent app navigation from feeling unplayable.

themes.description: Users express frustration over rigid binary gender choices, lack of non-binary or custom pronoun settings, and heteronormative or body-shaming assumptions in readings.
themes.recommendation: Expand onboarding profile settings to include non-binary/custom gender options, neutral pronouns, and relationship preferences to prevent misgendering and identity stereotyping.
